candidates.title: Did a Time Zone Break This Calendar Automation?
candidates.hook: Can this meeting survive a time-zone change?
candidates.experiment_plan: Create deterministic calendar fixtures crossing UTC offset and daylight-saving transitions; compare stored UTC instants and intended local times.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Input timezone IDs, ISO timestamps, created event IDs and exact assertion outcomes.
result_claims: In local Python zoneinfo simulation, 2026-11-01T01:30:00 America/Los_Angeles corresponds to two distinct valid UTC instants (08:30Z and 09:30Z).
Local guard requests clarification for ambiguous and nonexistent wall-clock times.
No real calendar API or AI agent was tested.

candidates.title: Can AI Read an Invoice Without Changing the Total?
candidates.hook: Let's check the invoice total against the source PDF.
candidates.experiment_plan: Use synthetic invoices with known totals, tax and line-item arithmetic; compare extractor outputs with deterministic expectations.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Synthetic invoice inputs, fields, expected totals, parsed outputs, checksum and scoring script.

candidates.title: Will This Automation Recover After a Restart?
candidates.hook: What happens to an unfinished job after a restart?
candidates.experiment_plan: Run a local queued workflow; terminate the worker mid-job and resume with/without persisted checkpoints.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Versioned worker logs, before/after job states, task outcomes and replay protocol.

candidates.title: Can Two API Calls Beat an AI Agent?
candidates.hook: Same task. One agent. One deterministic workflow.
candidates.experiment_plan: Specify a narrow task and equivalent quality assertions; test agent and direct-API implementation with matched inputs.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Task definition, exact run IDs, correctness scores, latency and tool/API usage, with caveats.

candidates.title: Does a Human Approval Step Prevent Bad Actions?
candidates.hook: Should this automation act or ask permission?
candidates.experiment_plan: Build a synthetic refund-approval workflow; compare unguarded and human-confirmation paths against allowed action policies.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Synthetic request fixtures, audit trail, allowed/blocked actions and action receipts.

candidates.title: What Does a $0-API Workflow Really Cost?
candidates.hook: No API bill. But is the workflow actually free?
candidates.experiment_plan: Measure local video generation hardware time, power or declared estimates, storage and human editing effort; avoid unmeasured cost claims.
candidates.evidence_to_capture: Dated run logs, energy-measurement method, local electricity tariff source, elapsed time and human-time ledger.
